newsitem.title: USA: Bass family to seek up to 25 pct in Fisher.
newsitem.headline: Bass family to seek up to 25 pct in Fisher.

text.p: A group led by the Bass Family of Fort Worth, Texas said Friday it plans to seek government approval to buy up to 25 percent of Fisher Scientific International Inc common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it will file immediately with the Federal Trade Commission under the Hart Scott Rodino Antitrust Inprovement Act and to request early termination.
They also said they intend to formally register their dissatisfaction with Fisher by withholding votes for the election of the board at the May 13 annual meeting.

They also intend to request a meeting with members of the board to discuss the company's performance and ways to enhance shareholder value and may request shareholder representation on the board of directors, the group said in the filing.
The Bass family holds a 9.8 percent stake in Fisher or 1,978,500 common shares.
In the filing, the group said its latest transactions took place from March 18 to May 2 at prices ranging from $35.74 to $45.40 per share.
The group said it holds the stake in the Hampton, N.H. supplier of scientific instruments, supplies and equipment for investment purposes.
